tasks.subject: Task 1: Register match warning codes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add NON_EXHAUSTIVE_MATCH and MATCH_WITHOUT_DEFAULT to the warning enum, default-level table, name table, and message switch (no behavior yet).

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_warning.h (enum ~L93; default_warning_levels ~L152)
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_warning.cpp (get_message ~L168; names ~L247)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Codes inserted after ONREADY_WITH_EXPORT, before the #ifndef DISABLE_DEPRECATED block
- NON_EXHAUSTIVE_MATCH default WARN; MATCH_WITHOUT_DEFAULT default IGNORE
- Matching entries in default_warning_levels, names, get_message
- Both static_asserts hold; engine builds

**Verify:** scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_warning.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_warning.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes", "acceptanceCriteria": ["codes after ONREADY_WITH_EXPORT before deprecated block", "levels WARN and IGNORE", "static_asserts hold", "builds"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Implement match exhaustiveness analysis
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add check_match_exhaustiveness() and call it from resolve_match so the warnings are emitted per the spec rules.

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.h (decl ~L98, DEBUG-guarded)
- Modify: modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.cpp (resolve_match ~L2733 + helper)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- resolve_match calls helper inside #ifdef DEBUG_ENABLED
- enum/bool missing values, no unguarded _ -> NON_EXHAUSTIVE_MATCH listing names
- full coverage / both bool -> no warning
- unguarded _/bind suppresses both
- guarded branches don't count toward coverage
- unguarded non-constant pattern bails out (no false positive)
- non-finite domain, no _ -> MATCH_WITHOUT_DEFAULT
- builds in debug and release

**Verify:** build succeeds; behavior verified by Task 3 fixtures

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.h", "modules/foundry_script/fs_analyzer.cpp"], "verifyCommand": "scons platform=macos target=editor dev_build=yes tests=yes", "acceptanceCriteria": ["helper called in resolve_match under DEBUG", "enum/bool partial -> NON_EXHAUSTIVE_MATCH", "full coverage no warning", "wildcard suppresses", "guard excluded from coverage", "non-constant bails", "non-finite -> MATCH_WITHOUT_DEFAULT"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Add FoundryScript fixtures and verify
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add 7 .fs/.out fixture pairs exercising each rule, generate expected output, review it, and confirm the full suite passes.

**Files (modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/analyzer/warnings/):**
- match_non_exhaustive_enum, match_exhaustive_enum_no_warning, match_non_exhaustive_enum_with_wildcard, match_enum_guarded_branch, match_enum_non_constant_pattern, match_bool_non_exhaustive, match_without_default (.fs + .out each)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- each .fs has func test(), produces only intended warnings
- non-exhaustive enum lists unhandled enumerators in declaration order
- full/wildcard/non-constant fixtures emit no match warning
- match_without_default emits MATCH_WITHOUT_DEFAULT (runner forces Warn)
- full test suite passes

**Verify:** ./bin/godot.<...> --headless --test --force-colors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/foundry_script/tests/scripts/analyzer/warnings/"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.<...> --headless --test --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["7 fixture pairs", "review generated .out matches intent", "no incidental UNUSED_/INT_AS_ENUM_ warnings", "suite green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Document the new settings
tasks.description:

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- match_without_default documented default="0" (between integer_division and missing_await)
- non_exhaustive_match documented default="1" (between native_method_override and onready_with_export)
